overview: A mild viral infection affecting the nose and throat.
treatment: Rest, hydration, and over-the-counter medicines to relieve symptoms.
home_care: Drink plenty of fluids, rest, and use warm liquids to soothe the throat.
prevention: Wash hands regularly, avoid close contact with infected individuals, and cover coughs and sneezes.
emergency_warning: Seek medical care if symptoms last more than 10 days, high fever develops, or breathing becomes difficult.

overview: A contagious viral infection that affects the respiratory system.
recommended_tests: Rapid influenza test or RT-PCR when clinically indicated.
treatment: Rest, fluids, antiviral medicines when prescribed, and fever control.
home_care: Stay hydrated, rest adequately, and monitor symptoms.
prevention: Receive annual influenza vaccination, practice hand hygiene, and avoid close contact with infected people.
emergency_warning: Seek immediate medical care if severe breathing difficulty, chest pain, or persistent high fever develops.

overview: A contagious respiratory illness caused by SARS-CoV-2.
recommended_tests: RT-PCR test or Rapid Antigen Test.
treatment: Supportive care and antiviral treatment when appropriate under medical supervision.
home_care: Rest, maintain hydration, isolate if contagious, and monitor oxygen saturation if advised.
prevention: Get vaccinated, practice hand hygiene, wear masks in crowded settings if needed, and maintain social distance.
emergency_warning: Seek emergency care if severe breathing difficulty, chest pain, or confusion develops.
